item.title: Join Us Today
item.description: We're always looking for new members! If you're a Monash student interested in ecology, conservation, computer science, or you just really like our vibe, fill out our recruitment interest form.

item.title: Support Our Mission
item.description:
Help us power the future of conservation! Your donation
directly supports our student-led environmental projects,
from AI-powered penguin monitoring to forest conservation
initiatives. Every contribution helps us develop innovative
technologies that make a real difference for our planet's
ecosystems.

item.title: Our Mission
item.description:
BiOM is more than just a student team. It’s a collaborative
space where young conservationists build skills, form
industry connections, and contribute meaningfully to
environmental causes. As we grow, so too does our commitment
to learning, curiosity, and action in the face of ecological
challenges.
